id.description: The scene's manifest key. scripts/generate-manifest.js indexes the file under this id (falling back to the filename stem when absent).

title.description: Visual header name of the scene. Takes precedence over 'name'.

name.description: Display name of the scene (used for map tags and fallback headers).

region.description: Region key from data/index.json indicating map grouping.

xpReward.description: One-time XP bonus awarded to the player upon their first entry.

descriptionHook.description: Optional runtime callback hook name (registered via engine.registerDescriptionHook) to append dynamic text.

background.description: CSS color expression used to draw room nodes on the map canvas.

description.description: Body text of the room. Can be a flat string or conditional variant array.

narration.description: Path to a narration clip played when this variant resolves on scene entry. Overrides the scene-level narration.

ambience.description: Path to a looping ambience file for this scene. Overrides the region's ambience from data/index.json; null silences the scene explicitly.

narration.description: Path to a narration clip played once per scene entry. A resolved description variant's narration takes precedence.

isBack.description: If true, sorts this option to the bottom as a 'back'/exit choice (locale-independent alternative to a 'return' action).

log.description: False silences logging; a string prints a custom narrative description.

item.description: Item ID required in inventory to enable choice.

timeCost.description: Ticks this option advances the world clock. Overrides rules.time.defaultCosts; 0 opts out explicitly.

retryText.description: Replacement option/log text once the check has been attempted: a string, or an array walked per failed attempt (clamped to the last entry). Attempt counts reset on scene re-entry.

skillCheck.description: Attribute ID to roll d20 check against.

actions.description: Action pipeline executed on successful checks (shorthand for outcomes.success.actions).

onFailure.description: Action pipeline executed on failed checks (shorthand for outcomes.failure.actions).

resolveOnce.description: Fail-forward: the check rolls exactly once and then retires permanently, whatever the tier. Route the failure/partial tiers somewhere real.

maxAttempts.description: Attempt budget. When it runs out without a success the check retires and onExhausted runs.

onExhausted.description: Pipeline run once when maxAttempts is exhausted — the authored way out (fail-forward alternative route).

resultText.description: Narrative checks (no dc, no items): the narration logged on use. A string, or an array walked per use (clamped to the last entry).

repeatable.description: Narrative checks: keep the option available after use instead of retiring it.

timeCost.description: Ticks one attempt advances the world clock. Overrides rules.time.defaultCosts.skillAttempt; 0 opts out explicitly.

items.description: Item-discovery entries supporting sequential search yields.

table.description: Loot table ID to draw random drop.

passiveChecks.description: Checks auto-rolled silently on the player's first entry, writing pass/fail into an author-named flag that conditions and description variants read. Rolled once per game.

skillCheck.description: Attribute ID to roll d20 check against.

flag.description: Flag the pass/fail result is written to.

text.description: Narration logged when the passive check succeeds. Silent otherwise.

supportsExhibits.description: If true, this scene supports exhibits curatorship.

showsReputation.description: If true, the curator plugin keeps the museum's reputation on screen under the scene name while the player is here.

museumSlot.description: Which slot off the museum hall this wing occupies. The curator plugin derives the scene's mapDefinitions geometry from it (even slots north of the hall, odd slots south, a pair per column), so a growing museum never needs hand-placed coordinates. Authored geometry is a fallback for running without the plugin.
museumSlot.$comment: Requires museumLayout in the curator's manifest config.

museumHall.description: Marks the museum's hall: the curator plugin widens it to span every slot column in use, making map room for the next wing, and offers the build-a-wing option there.

museumBuilt.description: Set by the curator plugin on a wing the player built, never authored. Such scenes are synthesized from the save on every load, so the flag is what tells them apart from authored rooms.
museumBuilt.$comment: Runtime-only — a scene file carrying this is a mistake.

displays.description: Initial display cases defined in this scene.

margin.description: critical: beat the DC by at least this much (default 5). partial: miss the DC by at most this much (default 3). Ignored on success/failure.

text.description: Narration logged when this tier lands.

outcomes.description: Margin-based outcome tiers. critical and partial only exist when authored; success/failure default to the legacy actions/onFailure pipelines. partial is the fail-forward tier: you get the thing, with a catch.

amount.description: loot/heal: integer. modify_resource: integer (negative drains) or "full".

resource.description: modify_resource: id of a resource declared in rules.playerDefaults.resources.

afterTicks.description: set_timer: deadline relative to the current tick.

until.description: advance_time: advance to the next start of this day segment.

actions.description: set_timer: the (quiet-only) pipeline run when the timer fires.

narration.description: Path to a narration clip played when this action runs — the read-aloud of its log text.

log.description: false silences the handler's default log line; a string overrides it. Override strings resolve through t(), so a locale key keeps the prose translatable; any other string logs as-is.

received.description: loot: the item was handed over (an NPC gift or reward) rather than found — selects the log message's locale key.

name.description: build_wing / add_display: the player-facing name of the new wing or display case.
